fresh-first-screen.says: A new, empty pod takes in a person's whole record and shows the first screen.
fresh-first-screen.total: Opening a new pod, importing the whole record and asking the first screen's questions: what a person waits for the first time.

measures.import: Importing the whole record into the pod.
measures.first-screen: Asking the questions the first screen shows.

scenario.open.says: Opening the pod: finding its folder, its keys and its saved state.

scenario.import.says: Bringing the whole record into the pod: converting it, checking it, saving it and judging which records are the same.

scenario.first-screen.says: Asking the questions the app's first screen shows, so the first screen can be drawn.

counts.records: How many records the person's source file holds.
counts.files-written: How many files the import wrote to the pod.
